Mutant Feature - Dog Ears.name: Mutant Feature - Dog Ears
Mutant Feature - Dog Ears.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Dog Ears
Soft, drooping dog ears that hang beside the face in place of human ears.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Dog Ears.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Two soft drooping dog ears hang from the upper sides of the head and replace the human ears; no human ears are drawn. They lie flat along the sides of the face down to about jaw level, with slightly longer fur at the edges. The fur follows the selected hair color; the inner skin, which shows only when an ear lifts, follows the selected skin color. The ears lift a little at the base with the expression.

Visual selection only: this is a permanent Mutant feature of the character's body; keep it consistent in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the character's Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two selected features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. A Quirkless character has no heteromorph body: if Quirkless or No Quirk was chosen, do not draw this feature.
